# v0.25.0-rc1 — long sessions: drain speed + correctness (#597, #750, #84, #808, #777, #509, #735, #24, #605)

**RELEASE CANDIDATE — not GA.** This prerelease enters the RELEASE-READINESS-V1 gauntlet
(bench/specs/RELEASE-READINESS-V1.md) at this tag:
- **Phase A:** the all-tools live matrix on a fresh clone across privacy postures, plus the planted-secret battery,
  bound to `hermes-lcm-x v0.25.0 (15 tools)`.
- **Phase B:** a P0/P1 sweep of the full `v0.24.9`→rc diff, with the upgrade path (a v0.24.9 store opened by this
  candidate) and the rollback path (this candidate → v0.24.9, plugin only).
- **Phase C:** a live `hermes acp` soak of 30+ turns, native OFF, with at least one committed compaction.
- **Hands-on cells**, candidate against `v0.24.9`, on the Hermes 0.21.2 and 0.21.5 trees and on the managed-profile
  runtime: the drain cells (`drain/hidden-backlog-*`), the crash and restart cells, and upgrade and rollback
  on one store.
- **Soak:** at least 24 h on an internal reference profile with the field-window counters, before GA.

GA follows only when the receipts are green, and the GA tree is this tree plus the `v0.25.0` release-notes file.
GA accepts when compaction p90 is at most 60 s and no compaction takes over 120 s on the gauntlet and the soak, the
drain cells pass, and no respin-bar defect (loss, duplicate rows, a wedge, a reset, an over-window request) is open.

Minor release on top of `v0.24.9` (`e36ae9c8`). Theme: long sessions. The hidden backlog drains at turn pace, deep
sessions keep their oldest condensed history in view, and the objective anchor no longer picks LCM's own summary row.
- No tool name or count changed (15 tools); `LCM plugin loaded` and every `lcm_*` name are unchanged.
- **Removed:** native recovery (`LCM_NATIVE_RECOVERY`; default off, and off on every managed profile). The key is
  ignored; a profile that still sets it to `true` gets one WARNING at load, and `false` is silent. Stores written while
  it was on keep their adoption proofs and snapshot digests, which LCM still reads. No new environment key.
- **Store:** no schema version change (schema 5), no new table and no new column; neither `db_bootstrap.py` nor
  `store.py` changed since `v0.24.9`. A rollback to `v0.24.9` is plugin-only (Phase B proves it on one store).
- No change below deletes a stored raw row.
- This release never moves a deployed pin by itself. A deployment moves only when its operator re-pins it.

## Changes since v0.24.9 (every change issue-first, reviewed at its exact head, receipted on its PR)

- **#597 (#820): the hidden backlog drains at turn pace.**
  - **Before.** When the host refused a compaction result after a pass that had stored leaves, LCM armed the 600 s
    no-progress hold, so the next automatic compaction could wait ten minutes although the pass had made progress.
  - **Now.** A refusal after a leaf-storing pass holds automatic compaction only until the end of the engine's next
    foreground turn (`host_rejected_progress`), with the 600 s backstop kept; auxiliary and stateless turn ends never
    clear it. A refusal without a stored leaf keeps the existing hold.
  - **Visible.** Hidden-backlog checks report `hidden_rows` as a count, a bounded count (`N+`) or `unknown` in sweep
    status and compaction logs; a capped empty scan warns once per conversation. Scheduling is unchanged.
  - **Measured.** On the managed-profile runtime's large drain cells, the next compaction after a refused
    leaf-storing pass runs at turn 165 (main before the fix: 174), and the holds end at turn end; 4/4 drain cells PASS.
  - **Not claimed.** The input-size change (A1 in #597) is not in this release; it waits on a latency measurement.
- **#750 (#768): deep sessions keep every summary depth in view.** Assembly and condensation found a session's
  summary depths through a node query capped at 1,000 rows, depth 0 first. From about 760 leaves (default fan-in 4,
  maximum depth 3) the oldest condensed levels dropped out of the model's context, and with unlimited depth,
  condensation stopped creating higher levels. A depth query with no row cap now feeds both. No stored row was lost:
  `lcm_grep` and `lcm_expand` always reached every node. A read-only count on managed deployments (2026-10-01) put
  the largest active session at about 180 depth-0 nodes; the sessions already past the limit were last active in August.
- **#84, LCM side (#781): the objective anchor no longer picks LCM's own summary row.** In a long tool run that crosses
  several compactions with no new user message, every second compaction rendered LCM's own summary under
  `[Current user objective preserved from compacted history]` and then repeated the summaries. The reverse scan now
  stops without an anchor when it reaches a verified LCM summary row before any real user row. The host-carrier half
  of #84 stays open (#576).
- **#808 (#814): one payload-directory scan per replay assembly.** Each tool result the aged stub tier admits used
  to list the whole large-output directory. A lookup index scoped to one assembly lists it once; a miss falls back to
  the original glob, so a payload another process writes during the assembly is still found. Measured with 7,000
  payload files and 40 eligible rows: the assembly takes 35 ms instead of 525 ms.
- **#777 and #509 (#803): native recovery removed.** With it on, compaction was not held to the foreground time
  budget (#777), and a rejected native summary armed no hold, so it was retried on every over-threshold turn (#509).
  It was off by default and on no managed profile, so the writer is deleted rather than fixed. Every reader of
  persisted native proofs and digests stays.
- **#735 (#822): a routine exit fit logs at INFO.** "LCM survival fit applied" with `reason=exit_fit:` is INFO; every
  other survival-fit line stays WARNING, and the text is unchanged, so probes that count it keep working.
- **#24 (#822): lock telemetry after a committed condensation.** When the frontier read right after a committed
  threshold-sweep condensation hits a SQLite lock, the fail-open telemetry reports the completed pass count, not 0.
- **#605 (#822, docs):** `compression.target_ratio` belongs to the host's built-in compressor; LCM-X does not read it.

## Bench and instruments (no runtime change)

- Reliability: drain and hidden-backlog cells with per-compaction counters (#801); gate exemptions limited to the
  bars each open target declares (#813) and, where declared, to one host (#822); cell scratch databases under
  `$TMPDIR`, deleted by default (#786); cancel-retry cells retargeted (#809); the managed-profile runtime joins the
  nightly matrix (#822); the B2 scorer pairs a held user composite with the parts the host stored apart (#804, #822).
- Recall: an explicit `--embeddings on|off` arm in the LongMemEval harness (#811); the row-1 run sheet, recall on
  the shipped full-text default (#812); the Track S material generator (#799).
- Docs: `VISION.md` and the roadmap by horizon and milestone (#790).

- **Every change red-first, at its exact head, cross-model reviewed** (codex gpt-6.1-sol where Claude wrote the
  change; a line-read by the release manager, another model family, where codex wrote it):
  - #820 (#597): line-read PASS 94 (codex wrote it) → bot round (3 fixed, 1 not applicable) → the codex review of
    the release manager's delta found one merge-blocking regression (a same-session conversation rebind stayed held
    600 s), fixed → PASS 98;
  - #768 (#750): codex review (its one merge-blocking item matched existing main behaviour) and a line-read of the
    diff and every caller; #781 (#84): codex high, 0 merge-blocking, both non-blocking items fixed;
  - #814 (#808): line-read (codex wrote it) and an independent codex review; #803 (#777, #509): line-read P1–P10
    PASS (codex wrote it) → codex review of the delta PASS 97, its one non-blocking wording item fixed;
  - #822 (#735, #24, #605, #804): line-reads PASS (codex wrote #735, #24, #605); the scorer and the nightly host
    (written by the release manager): FAIL 80 → fixed → PASS 94 → bot round → PASS 98 → PASS 97.
- Before the tag, #820 ran the drain cells on the managed-profile runtime (numbers above), and every new regression
  test fails on the head before its fix.
- Full suite at `7e105040` (the #822 merge): 5,625 passed, 92 skipped, 16 xfailed, 0 failed (the CI way).
- The gauntlet runs AT THE `v0.25.0-rc1` TAG (the phases at the top, on `v0.24.9..v0.25.0-rc1`), and its receipts
  are what the GA notes link.

## Known follow-ups

- #597 A1: a larger leaf input for faster drain; gated on a latency measurement on a real summariser route and a
  Track S quality check at that ratio.
- #626 (v0.28.0): a pre-turn compaction can outlast the host's bounded wait, so the turn runs uncompressed; the drain
  cells measure it.
- #821 (v0.26.0, with #553): on the managed-profile runtime, a crash right after a rotation stores two user turns
  twice and wedges publication, and in three more rotation cells the host keeps a held composite and its parts at
  once. Rotation-only, so not reachable on profiles that compact in place.
- #824 (v0.26.0): also rotation-only, and dependent on where the compactions fall: a crash right after a rotation can
  leave LCM holding one assistant reply the host never made durable. Nothing is lost and no host row is stored twice.
- #823 (bench): the B2 scorer's pairing of a held composite with its parts does not yet prove where the parts came from.
- #800: ordinary leaf preparation scans the whole summary archive (21-72 ms per 2,000-row page measured).
- #727, #725, #775: stub-first exit and survival-fit follow-ups from v0.24.9.
- #7: the ingest cursor can re-store tool rows (v0.26.0).

## Benchmark boundary

- No retrieval or QA benchmark claim is made by this release; the qualification is lifecycle reliability on real
  hosts. The recall re-baseline on the shipped default runs on its own track (#812).

## Upgrade

- Plugin only: verify the exact commit, install this tag at it and restart the gateway. The store needs no migration.
  A rollback to `v0.24.9` is plugin-only.
- `LCM_NATIVE_RECOVERY` can be removed from a profile: `true` is ignored with one WARNING at load, `false` is silent.
- No setting is needed for the drain change; the 600 s no-progress backstop is unchanged.
